subStrands.name: ICT Meaning, Hardware, Software and Threats

objectives.description: Meaning of ICT and its related terminologies; uses of ICT tools e.g. mobile phones, computers, internet, television set, radio, etc.; impact of ICT on education, social and economic development; information processing cycle — distinction between data and information; types and uses of computers.
Computer hardware: categories of computer hardware — system unit, peripherals and storage media.
Computer software: types of software — system and application software; open source and proprietary software.

Threats to computers and users: meaning of computer threats; categories — natural threats (earthquakes, heat, floods, etc.) and human threats (viruses, worms, intentional damage, etc.); health hazards to computer users — causes and effects; remedies to threats and hazards.

Word processing packages, their uses and importance; related concepts and terminologies; creating and saving documents; editing, formatting and insertion of objects e.g. tables, graphics, etc.; printing of documents; speed and accuracy in typing at 30–35 words per minute.

Spreadsheet packages, their uses and importance; related concepts and terminologies; types of data and their uses; creating and saving workbook; constructing and inserting formulae and functions; editing and formatting worksheets; printing worksheets.

subStrands.name: Presentations, Internet, Email and Communication Tools

objectives.description: Presentation packages, uses and importance; creating and saving presentations; editing, formatting and insertion of objects; slide shows; master slides; factors to consider before delivering a presentation; printing presentation documents.

The internet: meaning, concepts, terminologies and requirements; features and uses of browser windows; rules and regulations in the use of the internet (netiquette); sending and accessing e-mail; internet related tools for communication e.g. chatting, downloading, uploading, search engines, social media etc.
